exact_claim_text: Under the declared laboratory tasks, the prototype met the local response target in most sessions, while integrated task and feedback evidence identified comprehension and keyboard-navigation barriers that limit any broader accessibility claim.
method_or_source: Build-and-evaluate performance targets, quantitative task outcomes and qualitative explanations integrated through a predeclared joint display.
uncertainty: Small illustrative sample, artificial tasks, device variation, learning effects and incomplete accessibility coverage.
boundary: Local prototype, controlled tasks, illustrative sample of 16 participants and no production deployment or universal accessibility claim.
counter_evidence: Illustrative values only: the worked dataset records the local response target in 14 of 16 task sessions, while feedback identifies ambiguous urgency labels and one keyboard-navigation barrier. The joint display shows that fast response does not imply accessible comprehension.
stronger_wording_rejected: The prototype is accessible and ready for campus deployment.
